_README: SAMPLE LOI clause seed — DUMMY CONTENT ONLY. Body text here is placeholder,
not real Starbucks/Oculus language. Mike extracts the real 39 records against
THIS SHAPE. JSON (not CSV) because body_text carries brace codes, brackets and
internal line structure, records nest, and applies_when is structured.
clause -> variant -> position -> applies_when ; canonical_body shared + keyed.
Keys under `_comment` are documentation and are stripped by the loader.
`canonical_bodies` are declared once (keyed by code+source+version) and referenced
from positions by `canonical_body_ref` so the same baseline text is never duplicated.

canonical_bodies.body_text: [DUMMY] Tenant shall pay its proportionate share of Common Area Maintenance costs, {CAM0} capped at three percent (3%) annual increase over the prior calendar year, excluding taxes and insurance.
[DUMMY] Tenant shall pay its proportionate share of Common Area Maintenance costs, {CAM1} with no cap, subject to the exclusions in Exhibit C.
[DUMMY] In addition, Tenant shall pay all Net-Net-Net charges {NNN} including real estate taxes, insurance, and utilities directly attributable to the Premises.

clauses.title: Common Area Maintenance
clauses._comment_bucket: coded-position => wizard PROMPTS on selection. (custom-owned => preload no prompt; standing-default => use default no prompt.)
clauses.description: Landlord CAM recovery and cap position.
clauses.guidance_note: [DUMMY prose] Southeast prefers holding the 3% cap; concede the no-cap CAM1 only against a rent reduction. NEVER emitted into the document.

variants.description: CAM ladder for end-cap drive-thru deals.

positions._comment: ALTERNATIVE, rank 0, the Starbucks-preferred rung AND the Oculus standing default.
ALTERNATIVE, rank 1 fallback. Softer than national => deviation that trips approval; rule still pending Director, so rule_status is provisional and it links a director_question.
positions.internal_note: [DUMMY] Only take CAM1 with an offsetting concession elsewhere.
positions.deviation_rationale: [DUMMY] No-cap CAM deviates from the national 3%-cap position; conceded in exchange for X.
positions.landlord_fill_prompt: [DUMMY] Confirm the CAM exclusions list referenced in Exhibit C.

positions._comment: MODIFIER — NNN rides CAM (not a ladder rung). rank NULL, emit_order set, modifies_clause_id -> this clause. applies_when shows BOTH a deal_field condition AND a cross-clause clause_selection reference.
positions._comment_modifies: modifies_clause_id is given here as a clause_key; the loader resolves it to loi_clause.id.
positions.internal_note: [DUMMY] NNN attaches only on true triple-net structures.

applies_when._comment: condition_group 0, row A — DEAL FIELD reference (per-deal attribute).
applies_when.note: NNN modifier applies only when the deal's lease structure is triple-net.

applies_when._comment: condition_group 0, row B — CROSS-CLAUSE reference: this modifier depends on the CO clause's selected rung. ref_clause_key FKs to loi_clause.clause_key.
applies_when.note: Dummy cross-clause dependency example (rows A and B AND together within group 0).

director_questions._comment: Referenced by positions via director_question_key. One question can block many positions across clauses.
director_questions.question_text: [DUMMY] Is conceding the no-cap CAM1 sanctioned regionally, or does it require corporate approval?

_notes_on_shared_tables: loi_approval_label and loi_config are seeded by the migration, not per-clause.
canonical_bodies with the same (brace_code, source, version) must be byte-identical
across the whole seed set — the DB unique constraint rejects a divergent duplicate,
which is exactly the national-vs-Southeast CO1 collision guard.
